items.title: Electricity restored in Bidur Wards 10 and 11 of Nuwakot

items.summary: Kathmandu, September 9 Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) chair Rabi Lamichhane is set to address the House of Representatives on Wednesday, focusing on the response to the devastating flood in Rasuwa. items.title: Climate justice is still far away for Nepal
items.summary: By Surabhi Sharma The Bhotekoshi flood has left Nepal confronting one of its harshest human tragedies. A massive rock-and-ice avalanche unleashed a devastating surge through the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli river system, destroying lives, homes and critical infrastructure within minutes.
